value.content: {"id": "portswigger_authentication", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "authentication", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Authentication Vulnerabilities", "name": "Authentication Mechanics, Username Enumeration & MFA Bypass Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-287", "owasp_category": "A07:2021 - Identification and Authentication Failures", "signals": ["username_enumeration_via_subtle_errors", "response_time_discrepancy", "missing_rate_limiting", "password_reset_poisoning", "2fa_flawed_logic", "remember_me_cookie_flaw"], "verification_strategy": "Analyze login endpoint error responses for subtle text discrepancies ('Invalid username' vs 'Incorrect password') or response time variations. Evaluate 2FA workflows for step skipping, brute-force limits on OTP tokens, and predictable password reset tokens.", "evidence_requirements": ["error_message_divergence", "time_differential_distribution", "mfa_step_bypass_proof"], "tools": [{"tool": "ffuf (Enum)", "cmd": "ffuf -u 'https://example.com/login' -d 'user=FUZZ&pass=test' -w users.txt -mr 'Invalid password'", "desc": "Audits username enumeration via differential response matching"}, {"tool": "AutonomousBrain (Auth Auditor)", "cmd": "AutonomousBrain.audit_auth_flow(login_url)", "desc": "Assesses lockout thresholds, rate limiting, and password reset logic"}], "remediation": "Return generic error messages for all authentication failures (e.g. 'Invalid username or password'). Enforce rate limiting, account lockouts, and robust time-constant cryptographic comparison for password verification.", "description": "PortSwigger Authentication vulnerabilities encompass username enumeration via different responses, password brute-forcing bypassing IP checks via X-Forwarded-For, 2FA bypass via broken logic, and remember-me cookie tampering."}
